slug: 从鹰人进化为天使后我荡平诸神
lines: 费兰德世界。
泰坦与龙时代。
草原和森林交界之处的高蛮山。
大日当空，烈烈如焦！
“高蛮山部落，王廷有令！征召鹰人战士五十名！限期三日，赶赴瀚海森林听从雷霆之神号令！”
山崖上空。
一位灰黑羽翼的鹰人振翅于半空，手爪握持一柄骨制长矛，对着山崖上的鹰人们高喝道。
下方山崖上，鹰人群之中。
姜尤迷茫地抬起头来，看向身周和天上。
“我这是….到了什么地方？！”
很快，他便发现了不同。
周围皆是人面鸟喙，鹰足鹰翼，全身覆盖灰黑羽毛的鹰人。
鹰人们身披简陋的兽皮衣，身材瘦弱，面带菜色，一看就知道是长期营养不良所致。
而他自己，则还是一个幼年鹰人，站在一位母鹰人的身边。
很快，幼年鹰人的短暂记忆便浮现至他的脑海。
“使者！我族鹰人总共不过两百人，若是青壮皆走，还怎么在这大荒之中生存，还请宽限一些。”
山崖上的鹰人群中，一位身材高大的壮年鹰人站在最前，朝着半空中的鹰人使者乞求道。
然而使者并不在意他们的死活，只道一声。
“哼，我不管这些，如期至可活，不至便灭你部落！”
说完，便振翅一跃，飞向他处，只留下满脸凄惶的鹰人们。
夜晚。
山崖上聚起一堆篝火。
上面烤炙着鹰人部落仅存的一些肉食。
鹰人青壮们默默地吃着肉，在他们身旁，则是他们的亲眷。
姜尤同样和母亲站在一位男性鹰人身旁。
男性鹰人身材高大，正是这支鹰人部落的族长，白日里乞求使者宽限的高大鹰人。
他吃完肉食，转头看向姜尤，叹息一声，摸着他的脑袋，笑道。
“我儿一定要健康长大！”
姜尤闻言，虽然已经换了一个人，但融合了幼年鹰人的记忆，依旧有些触动。
然后，他便看向女鹰人，郑重道。
“阿芝，泰坦神族和太古龙族的战争已经持续了一千年。十年前，我们的父辈一去不返。这一次，我们这一去，同样生死难料。我走后，阿尤便靠你抚养长大了。”
女鹰人眼角湿润。
“翼，难道就不能不去吗，我们离开高蛮山，躲的远远的。”
“不行的，整个世界，都被泰坦和巨龙分割统治。在这里，我们还能苟延残喘。去往别处，只能覆灭。”
鹰父无奈道。
“翼啊，你一定要平安归来！”
content_en:
Philander World.
Age of Titans and Dragons.
Gaoman Mountain is at the junction of grassland and forest.
The sun is high in the sky, as fierce as a scorch!
"Gaoman Mountain Tribe, the royal court has an order! Recruit fifty Yingmen warriors! Within three days, rush to the Hanhai Forest to obey the order of the God of Thunder!"
Over the cliff.
An eagle man with gray and black wings flapped his wings in the air, holding a bone spear in his claws, and shouted to the hawk men on the cliff.
On the cliff below, among the eagles.
Jiang You raised his head in confusion and looked around him and at the sky.
"Where am I...?"
Soon, he noticed the difference.
All around were hawks with human faces, bird beaks, eagle feet and eagle wings, and their bodies covered with gray and black feathers.
The hawks were dressed in simple animal skin clothing. They were thin and had a disheveled look on their faces. It was obvious at a glance that they were caused by long-term malnutrition.
And he himself was still a young hawk, standing next to a female hawk.
Soon, the short memory of the young Eagle Man came to his mind.
"Messenger! There are only two hundred of our Ying people. If all the young and strong people leave, how can we survive in this wilderness? Please be more lenient."
Among the crowd of eagles on the cliff, a tall and mature eagle man stood at the front, begging to the eagle messenger in mid-air.
However, the messenger didn't care about their life or death, he just said a word.
"Hmph, I don't care about this. I'll survive as expected. If not, I'll destroy your tribe!"
After saying that, he fluttered his wings and flew away, leaving only the hawks with frightened faces.
night.
A bonfire was gathered on the cliff.
Some of the remaining meat from the Eagle Tribe was grilled on it.
The young and strong Yingren ate the meat silently, and beside them were their relatives.
Jiang You was also standing with his mother next to a male hawk.
The tall male hawk is the leader of this hawk tribe, the tall hawk who begs the messenger for mercy during the day.
After finishing the meat, he turned to look at Jiang You, sighed, touched his head, and smiled.
"My son must grow up healthy!"
When Jiang You heard this, although he had changed into a different person, he was still a little touched by the memory of the young Yingren.
Then, he looked at the female hawk and said solemnly.
"Azhi, the war between the Titan Protoss and the Ancient Dragon Clan has been going on for a thousand years. Ten years ago, our fathers passed away forever. This time, when we leave, life and death are also unpredictable. After I left, Ayou was raised by you."
The corners of the female Hawkman's eyes were moist.
"Yi, can't we not go? Let's leave Gaoman Mountain and hide far away."
"No, the entire world is divided and ruled by Titans and dragons. Here, we can still survive. If we go elsewhere, we will only be destroyed."
Eagle Father said helplessly.
"Yi, you must come back safely!"
